title: New Days
overview: Tempest is thriving after the success of its festival, but unexpected trouble has arisen with the new dungeon.

title: The Dungeon Evolves
overview: Rimuru and his trusted companions discuss ideas for improving the dungeon.

title: The Avatar Team Is Formed
overview: Rimuru, Ramiris, Veldora, and Milim work on perfecting their avatars before facing Team Green Fury.

title: Invitation
overview: The Council of the West deliberates on whether to grant membership to Tempest.

title: The First Step
overview: Rimuru attends the meeting that will determine Tempest's membership in the Council of the West.

title: The Council of the West
overview: A list of unreasonable demands from the Council makes Rimuru realize that a deeper plot is in motion.

title: The Mastermind's Identity
overview: An interrogation of Prince Elric's would-be shooter reveals who's pulling the strings behind the Council.

title: The Groundwork of Greed
overview: Glenda reveals all she knows about the Council and the Rozzos, and Rimuru prepares to inspect ancient ruins.

title: Investigating the Ruins
overview: The investigation of the ancient ruins of Amrita begins.

title: The Master of Greed
overview: Rimuru and Mirabel come face-to-face at last in the ancient ruins.

title: Milim's Friend
overview: Rimuru helps Milim confront the Chaos Dragon, a corrupted form of the baby dragon that was once her friend.

title: Tempest Evolves
overview: Rimuru shares his plans for Tempest's future, including a new system of government and Council representation.

title: New Companions
overview: Ramiris and Veldora are feeling overworked, so they ask Rimuru to find assistants for them.

title: The Black Numbers
overview: Diablo returns with new demon subordinates to add to Tempest's ranks.

title: An Unsettling Feeling
overview: As Tempest continues to grow and evolve, the Moderate Harlequin Alliance approaches Demon Lord Leon.

title: Gran, the Hero of Dawn
overview: Luminus meets with Rimuru to discuss Gran and future plans.

title: Lubelius, the Point of Convergence
overview: While Leon seeks Elmesia's help in finding Chloe, Granville's forces invade Lubelius.

title: Turbulence in the West
overview: An army of demons advances from the north, leaving the Western Nations in turmoil.

title: Death and Loss
overview: Granville's true plan is revealed, but it may already be too late to stop it.

title: Chronoa the Hero (1)
overview: When Chloe's Time Traveler skill kicks in, Hinata's soul is sent to the past along with her.

title: Chronoa the Hero (2)
overview: Chloe and Hinata meet Luminus and begin their journey as Chronoa.

title: Where the Soul Resides
overview: Chronoa is freed from her seal—not as a Hero, but as an avatar of destruction.
